description: A preset the server does not offer in the Accept of a request whose Content-Type is offered (base): the Accept lists no preset the server offers, 406 with RPP-Code 02004 (core 14.3).
comment: Skipped on epp-docker: the EPP config signals the preset by the RPP-Preset header; preset_signalling_header/ covers the header method.

steps.comment: Reads domain b3, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:epp-compatible"; preset-version="1.0"; expects 406 02004. An error answer this case checks. Only where the server offers no epp-compatible preset (rri-mtest).

Reads domain b3, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; preset="de.denic.rpp.preset.rri"; preset-version="1.0"; expects 406 02004. The error answer this case checks. Only where the server offers no rri preset (epp-docker).
